fusions.name: Weed Snarl
fusions.desc: Throws out strands of weed that deal 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stun each for 1 second and leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Rip
fusions.desc: A tearing bite that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Mat
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs 20 damage for 12 seconds, and raises your armour by 6% while it holds.

fusions.name: Knot by Knot
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
